purpose: Build first-class queryable institutional cognition layer for Parking Lot, Continuity Brief, document sweeper, promotion gates, freeze governance, rituals, and playbook automation.
required_actions: Apply sql/001_continuity_operational_cognition.sql to Supabase ops database or staging-safe equivalent.
Verify ops.institutional_intents, ops.recovered_cognition, ops.continuity_playbook_items, ops.freeze_scopes, ops.continuity_health and ops.quiet_drift_candidates exist.
Register house rules: PARALLEL_FORWARD_CHARGE, CONTINUITY_FIRST_QUEUING, NO_FUTURE_TENSE_AS_PRESENT_TENSE, PILOT_FREEZE_RESTRAINT.
Run document-sweeper against a small safe test document and insert recovered cognition candidates.
Run ritual-engine against sample institutional intents and store one MORNING_BRIEF and one EVENING_CLOSURE ritual run.
Run promotion-gates against one sample intent and confirm production promotion is blocked without REAL receipts.
Run freeze-governance and confirm pilot freeze blocks feature additions while allowing manual tracking and scratchpad capture.
Run continuity-speedo and store result as PARTIAL diagnostic until validated against live data.
Update Reality Ledger with exact migration result, checks, failures, retries, and unresolved gaps.

hard_gates.prod_promotion: BLOCKED unless runtime receipt, telemetry receipt, replay receipt, rollback path, no freeze conflict, no unresolved ambiguity, and human validation exist.
hard_gates.automation: May classify and suggest; must not silently redefine intent, bypass freeze, self-certify REAL, or promote to prod.
hard_gates.freeze: 7-day pilot scope is frozen. No feature expansion during pilot.
